jobs.title: Sr. Principal Product Management – Software and Digital Platforms
jobs.location: US, TX, Austin, Plaza on the Lake
jobs.description:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .

Principal Product Management – Software and Digital Platforms
The Principal/Sr. Principal Product Manager for Software and Digital Platforms (SDP) is a senior individual contributor responsible for defining products, translating market and business needs into executable requirements, and driving alignment across business units, engineering, and program teams. This role serves as a technical and commercial bridge between vertical end-market teams and the SW, Digital, and AI development teams.
Key Product Management Responsibilities:
- Partner with business unit marketing, engineering teams, and customers to translate business needs for SW, Digital, and AI either into stakeholder product requirements, focusing on the “what” needs to be built and the “why”.
- Define product scope, use cases, feature priorities, and requirements for software and digital platform offerings, ensuring requirements are technically sound, validated with engineering, traceable and verifiable through delivery.
- Work closely with software, embedded, systems, and hardware engineering teams to refine requirements, resolve tradeoffs, and ensure products are architected for usability, scalability, and reuse across multiple markets.
- Contribute to roadmap planning and prioritization for software-enabled products and platform capabilities, balancing customer demand, strategic value, technical feasibility, and resource constraints.
- Develop business cases and support project scoping, including assessment of development effort, cost considerations, lifecycle implications, and long-term platform reuse opportunities.
- Clarify the product lifecycle from concept through launch, support, and end of life, ensuring clear plans for release readiness, sustaining needs, and customer adoption.
- Engage directly with customers and internal stakeholders to gather insights, evaluate product fit, and shape product direction based on application needs, feedback, and competitive dynamics.
- Partner with program management and development teams during quarterly planning and execution cycles to provide clear priorities, decision support, and visibility to roadmap changes, risks, and dependencies.
- Influence platform strategy by identifying opportunities to standardize software components, improve developer experience, and expand reusability of embedded software and digital assets across product lines.
- Collaborate with vertical business unit applications, marketing, and enablement teams to ensure product requirements, positioning, documentation, and customer-facing collateral accurately reflect the intended value proposition and technical capabilities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Partner with vertical BU applications and engineering teams to ensure early customer experience, evaluation flows, and product readiness considerations are incorporated into product plans.
- Work with embedded software and systems teams to understand architecture decisions, development tradeoffs, and validation needs in order to make informed product decisions.
- Support go-to-market readiness by aligning product documentation, evaluation platforms, and customer-facing collateral with roadmap commitments and launch objectives.
- Help drive issue resolution and prioritization across development, applications, and support teams throughout the product lifecycle.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related technical field; advanced degree or MBA is a plus.
- 10+ years of experience in product management, systems engineering, applications engineering, or a related role supporting embedded products.
- Demonstrated experience managing or defining products that include embedded software, firmware, or software-enabled hardware platforms.
- Hands-on understanding of embedded software development practices, software lifecycle considerations, and the interaction between firmware, drivers, middleware, hardware, and end applications.
- Experience translating customer and market needs into detailed product requirements and driving cross-functional alignment through execution.
- Strong technical and business judgment, including the ability to assess product tradeoffs, prioritize features, and contribute to business case development.
- Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence engineering, business, and customer teams without direct authority.
- Understanding of competitive dynamics, customer workflows, and software platform trends in embedded and digital product environments.

jobs.description:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .

Analog Devices is seeking a Staff Product Manager to define and lead the productization roadmap for our Physical Intelligence (PI) software stack. Product Marketing Manager
Position Summary
Analog Devices is seeking an experienced Product Marketing Manager to lead the strategy, business growth, and commercialization of the Controller Solutions Division (CSD) portfolio, with primary responsibility for Hybrid Controllers, Charge Pump Controllers, Bi-Directional Controllers, and Buck/Boost/Buck-Boost/Bi-directional controller solutions. This role will drive portfolio strategy and customer engagement across broad-market industrial, automotive, aerospace & defense, automation, robotics, and emerging humanoid applications.  Responsibilities align with ownership of CSD controller strategy, hybrid controller initiatives, and broad-market growth opportunities.

The successful candidate will serve as the market and customer advocate, translating emerging application requirements into differentiated product roadmaps while driving revenue growth, strategic design wins, and long-term portfolio investments.  This role requires a strong combination of technical expertise, business acumen, and customer-facing leadership.

Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership
- Own the business strategy, product roadmap, and marketing execution for the Controller portfolio
- Define and execute portfolio growth strategies aligned with emerging market opportunities and customer needs.
- Develop business cases, market requirements documents, and long-term investment plans for new product development.
- Manage product lifecycle activities to maximize revenue, profitability, and market share.
- Identify adjacent market opportunities enabled by wide band-gap solutions (GaN), advanced power architectures, battery backup systems, and intelligent power management technologies.

Market & Customer Leadership
- Engage directly with strategic customers, system architects, and engineering teams to understand future power system requirements.
- Establish trusted relationships with customers across Industrial Automation, Robotics and Humanoid Robotics, Automotive Electronics and Electrification, Aerospace & Defense, Energy Storage Systems, Communications Infrastructure, amongst others
- Translate customer requirements into actionable product definitions and roadmap priorities.
- Support executive-level customer engagements, roadmap reviews, and design-win activities.

Business Management
- Own revenue, forecasting, design-win pipeline, and growth objectives for assigned product families.
- Monitor business performance, customer adoption, market trends, competitive positioning, and profitability.
- Develop market models including TAM, SAM, and SOM analyses for targeted growth segments.
- Drive business reviews and portfolio updates with senior leadership.

Product Definition & Commercialization
- Partner closely with engineering, applications, and product definition teams to develop next-generation controller solutions.
- Influence architectural direction based on customer requirements, competitive analysis, and return-on-investment considerations.
- Drive release-to-sales (RTS) readiness for new products and technology platforms.
- Lead product launches, positioning, pricing recommendations, customer communications, and sales enablement activities.

Go-to-Market Execution
- Develop value propositions, product messaging, and competitive positioning strategies.
- Create customer-facing collateral, presentations, competitive analysis, and sales training materials.
- Support strategic design-win pursuit activities and key customer qualification efforts.
- Collaborate with field sales and applications engineering teams to accelerate opportunity conversion and revenue growth.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis
- Monitor industry trends and technology developments.
- Conduct competitive benchmarking and develop portfolio recommendations to maintain technology leadership.
- Provide market insights that influence portfolio investment decisions and future technology roadmaps.

Cross-Functional Leadership
- Lead cross-functional collaboration across Product Definition, Engineering, Applications, Operations, Finance, and Sales organizations.
- Drive alignment on product priorities, customer engagements, launch readiness, and resource allocation.
- Influence stakeholders without direct authority and ensure execution against strategic business objectives.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
- 10+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Product Management, Business Management, Applications Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related semiconductor industry roles.
- Strong understanding of: - DC-DC Power Conversion
- Power Management ICs
- Industrial and Automotive Power Solutions

- Demonstrated experience developing product strategies and bringing semiconductor products to market.
- Strong customer engagement and presentation skills with the ability to interface at both engineering and executive levels.
- Proven ability to drive cross-functional teams and influence product direction.

Preferred Qualifications
- MBA or advanced technical degree.
- Experience working with OEMs, industrial automation companies, automotive customers, aerospace & defense contractors, or robotics system developers.
- Understanding functional safety, reliability, and system-level power architectures.
- Experience with wide band-gap intelligent power management, and advanced control solutions.

jobs.description:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .

Location:
Dallas, TX, Wilmington, MA, San Jose, CA or Detroit, MI

Position Overview:
The GMSL (Gigabit Multimedia Serial Link) group within Analog Devices is responsible for pioneering high-speed connectivity solutions for the automotive, industrial, and consumer electronics industries. We provide solutions that enable video, data, and audio transmission over a single cable, simplifying designs and enhancing the overall performance and reliability of electronic systems.

We are seeking an experienced and results-oriented Strategic Marketing Manager to join our GMSL team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the development and execution of comprehensive marketing strategies that promote our GMSL solutions in Automotive markets. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the brand and growth trajectory of our GMSL product portfolio, while also identifying market trends, customer needs, and new business opportunities to drive product adoption and revenue growth.

As a strategic leader with a system-level understanding of Vehicle E/E platforms and Infotainment systems to help the team define the value proposition of our products, the person should be able to create compelling go-to-market strategies and communicate product value propositions to the customers effectively. The successful candidate should be able to drive integrated marketing plans through strong program management and soft skills by collaborating with a cross-functional team consisting of various stakeholders, including the Engineering, Sales, and the Global Operations teams.

Responsibilities: ​
- Market Research: Conduct in-depth market research and analysis to understand customer needs, industry trends, and competitive landscape to inform product positioning and messaging.

- Strategic Planning: Develop and implement marketing strategies and plans to support the growth of GMSL products and solutions, ensuring alignment with overall company goals and objectives. Identify and investigate new or emerging markets and applications to extend SAM and drive future growth

- Customer Engagement: Build and maintain relationships with key customers and partners in automotive market segment in your region, acting as a trusted advisor to understand their challenges and develop solutions.

- Product Positioning and Messaging: Define and communicate the value proposition of GMSL solutions, ensuring clear and effective messaging that resonates with target audiences.

- Product Launches: Lead go-to-market planning and execution for new product launches, define pricing strategies by collaborating with cross-functional teams (sales, engineering, and product management) to ensure successful market entry.

- Sales Enablement: Provide sales teams with the tools, training, and collateral they need to effectively sell GMSL products and solutions. Work closely with sales leadership to identify and capitalize on sales opportunities. Drive go-to-market strategies, RFIs / RFPs / RFQs and execute design win plans.

- Brand Awareness: Enhance brand visibility for GMSL solutions through digital marketing, industry events, trade shows, webinars, and other marketing channels.

- Metrics and Reporting: Monitor and report on the performance of marketing programs and initiatives, using data and insights to continually optimize and improve effectiveness. Support leadership team in forecast and business reporting.

- Collaboration: Work closely with product management, engineering, sales, and other internal teams to ensure seamless alignment and execution of marketing initiatives.

Requirements:
- Minimum Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Master’s in Business Administration with engineering background or equivalent

- 2+ years of experience in related product marketing, applications, strategic marketing, or business development role, ideally within the semiconductor, electronics, or technology industries.

- Experience with articulating technical concepts and value propositions to customers and discussing system requirements.

- Demonstrate leadership skills and self-starter mindset to drive new businesses.

- Ability to work across a large organization and diverse teams.

- Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.

- Ability to travel for customer and partner meetings as required.

Beneficial Skills:
- Demonstrate strong business acumens with awareness of best marketing, research, and business planning practices.

- Strong knowledge of GMSL technology, high-speed Automotive connectivity, Consumer Video, Vehicle E/E architecture, and Infotainment systems in cars.

jobs.description:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .

Empowering the Intelligent Edge
Our solutions help customers transform raw data into actionable insights and make connected devices smarter and more responsive. With our analog and mixed-signal devices, power management, radio frequency offerings, and edge processors and sensors, we harness and activate the data that bridges the physical and digital worlds.

Whatever breakthroughs are next—in aerospace, automotive, sustainable energy, communications, digital healthcare, industrial automation, instrumentation, or consumer, ADI will be there to keep you ahead of what’s possible.

The Role
ADI is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead product strategy and execution for a portfolio of enterprise AI agents and assistants. Reporting to the Head of Enterprise AI , this leader will build and develop a high-performing team of product managers and establish a consistently high standard for product thinking, written requirements, prioritization, and partnership with science and engineering.

The role will own the vision, roadmap, and investment choices for enterprise agents and assistants. It will determine which use cases ADI should pursue, sequence, defer, or decline, grounding those decisions in business value, user needs, technical feasibility, risk, and the evolving capabilities of AI. The role will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, translating real workflows and pain points into clear requirements, success criteria, and executable scope.

This is a strategically important role in ADI's Enterprise AI agenda. It will ensure that AI investment is directed toward valuable, adoptable products with measurable outcomes, and that launches are supported by effective alignment, communication, and change management across the organization.

Key Responsibilities
Product Management Leadership & Team Development
Build a strong product management organization that combines rigorous product practice with credible partnership across science, engineering, and the business.
- Recruit, lead, coach, and retain a high-performing team of product managers responsible for enterprise AI products.
- Set clear standards for product thinking, discovery, written requirements, prioritization, decision quality, and product reviews.
- Develop the team's ability to work credibly with data science, ML engineering, software engineering, design, and business stakeholders.
- Create clear accountability, career development, and operating mechanisms that enable the team to perform consistently at a high level.

Agent & Assistant Product Strategy
Define the vision, portfolio strategy, and roadmap for enterprise agents and assistants, making disciplined choices about where ADI should invest.
- Establish a clear product vision and multi-horizon roadmap for a portfolio of enterprise AI agents and assistants.
- Decide which use cases to pursue, sequence later, defer, or decline based on user value, business impact, technical feasibility, risk, and cost.
- Distinguish between capabilities that can be delivered reliably today and those that depend on emerging technical maturity.
- Maintain a coherent portfolio view that balances near-term delivery with longer-term platform and capability development.

Business Partnership & Product Definition
Build active partnerships with business stakeholders and convert real workflows and pain points into precise product direction.
- Lead discovery with business stakeholders and users to understand workflows, decisions, pain points, constraints, and unmet needs.
- Translate insights into crisp product requirements, success criteria, scope, user journeys, and acceptance conditions.
- Ensure science and engineering teams can execute without repeated reinterpretation by resolving ambiguity early and documenting decisions clearly.
- Challenge requests constructively, separating underlying user problems from proposed solutions and avoiding low-value or poorly defined use cases.

Impact Measurement & Portfolio Decisions
Define how product success is measured, reviewed, and used to redirect investment across the Enterprise AI portfolio.
- Establish a balanced product scorecard covering adoption, task completion, user trust and satisfaction, grounding, relevance, and other quality measures.
- Connect product performance to business outcomes such as time saved, productivity improvement, cost avoided, risk reduced, or service quality improved.
- Run a regular review cadence that makes progress, underperformance, risk, and learning visible to product teams and executives.
- Use performance evidence and user feedback to scale successful products, adjust roadmaps, improve weak experiences, or stop investments that are not delivering value.

Cross-Functional Product Delivery
Create alignment across the functions required to design, build, launch, and improve enterprise AI products.
- Drive shared priorities and decisions across data science, engineering, design, content, platform, data, security, legal, and go-to-market or enablement teams.
- Lead product planning from discovery through requirements, build, evaluation, release readiness, launch, and iteration.
- Clarify ownership, dependencies, decision rights, and trade-offs so teams can move quickly without compromising quality or responsible AI expectations.
- Communicate roadmap choices, delivery progress, constraints, and risks clearly to executives and other stakeholders.

Launch, Adoption & Change Management
Ensure that shipped products are understood, adopted, and incorporated into the workflows they are intended to improve.
- Own launch planning and coordinate readiness across product, technology, content, communications, enablement, support, and business teams.
- Define target users, rollout sequencing, adoption plans, feedback channels, and support requirements for each launch.
- Partner with business leaders and change teams to embed agents and assistants into real workflows rather than treating release as the end point.
- Use adoption and usage evidence to identify friction, refine the experience, strengthen enablement, and improve product value over time.

Experience
- 12+ years of experience in product management, including 6+ as a people leader
- Significant experience leading product management teams responsible for complex software, AI, data, platform, or enterprise technology products.
- Demonstrated success defining product vision, portfolio strategy, roadmaps, and investment priorities in technically complex environments.
- Strong product discovery skills, with experience converting business workflows and user pain points into clear requirements, success criteria, and executable scope.
- Experience partnering closely with data science, machine learning, and engineering teams to deliver products from concept through production and continuous improvement.
- Working knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, assistants, evaluation, grounding, and the practical limits of current AI capabilities.
- Proven ability to create prioritization and governance mechanisms that balance user value, business impact, feasibility, cost, risk, quality, and responsible AI considerations.
- Experience defining and reviewing product metrics across adoption, completion, trust, satisfaction, quality, and measurable business outcomes.
- Strong written communication and product documentation skills, with the ability to create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences.
- Experience leading launches, adoption programs, and organizational change for enterprise products or new ways of working.
- Executive-level communication and influencing skills, with the judgement to explain trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and align senior stakeholders.
- A leadership style that combines strategic direction, customer and user focus, rigorous decision-making, talent development, and strong cross-functional partnership.
- Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, engineering, design, or a related field is required; an advanced degree is preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

What does success look like?
- A high-performing product management team is established, with consistently strong product thinking, written requirements, prioritization, and partnership with science and engineering.
- ADI has a clear, credible, and actively managed roadmap for enterprise agents and assistants, with explicit decisions on which use cases to pursue, sequence, defer, or decline.
- Business workflows and user problems are translated into clear, stable product requirements and success criteria that delivery teams can execute without repeated reinterpretation.
- Product performance is reviewed through a trusted scorecard that connects adoption, task completion, trust, satisfaction, grounding, and relevance to measurable business outcomes.
- Launch and change management practices lead to sustained adoption, and performance evidence is used to redirect investment toward the products and capabilities creating the greatest value.
